title: Chickpea Curry and Spice-Roasted Parsnips
subtitle: with Basmati Rice and Coriander
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you’re vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Roast parsnip: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced (see Make it yours). Line an oven tray with baking paper. Peel the parsnips, quarter lengthwise and put on the lined tray. Drizzle with 1 tbs olive oil, scatter over 1 tsp curry powder, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast for 20-25 mins until golden and tender.

Cook rice: Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Add the rice and cook for 12 mins or until tender. Drain. While the rice is cooking, pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Start curry: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the coriander stems and garlic, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant.

Simmer curry: Add the chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk, remaining curry powder, 1 tbs tomato paste, 2 tsp sugar and 80ml (⅓ cup) water to the coriander mixture and stir to combine. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook for 10 mins or until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Divide the rice and chickpea curry among bowls. Top with the roasted parsnip and scatter over the coriander leaves. Enjoy!

Make it yours: Don't feel like turning on your oven? Peel the parsnip and cut into 2cm chunks. Add to the curry with the chickpeas and cook for 10 mins or until the curry is thickened and the parsnip is tender.
